prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There is **no single best AI video ad maker** for every use case; the best choice depends on the ad type and workflow. Among the sources you provided, **HeyGen** is the strongest *overall* pick for broad ad creation, while **Creatify**, **Arcads**, and **Revid.ai** are better fits for more specific workflows.[1][2][13][19]

If you want the **best overall** option, **HeyGen** is the most consistently recommended in the results for ad creation because it combines strong avatar quality, multilingual output, and automated ad creation.[1][14] HeyGen’s review specifically says it handled all test ad formats without needing a second tool.[1]

If you want the **best by use case**, the results point to this split:[2][13][19]

| Use case | Best pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Broad all-around ad creation | **HeyGen** | Strong avatar realism, multilingual reach, and automated ad workflows.[1][14] |
| E-commerce/product ads | **Creatify** | Repeatedly recommended for product-focused, UGC-style performance ads.[2][13] |
| UGC-style performance ads | **Arcads** | Specialized for actor-style, realistic UGC ads.[2][6] |
| Short-form paid social editing | **Revid.ai** | Best overall AI video editor for short-form ad workflows.[19] |

If you want a single recommendation without more context, I’d choose **HeyGen** as the safest **best overall AI video ad maker** from these results.[1][14] If your goal is specifically **high-converting product ads**, **Creatify** is the more targeted pick.[2][13]

If you want, I can also rank the top 5 options by **price**, **realism**, or **best for Meta/TikTok ads**.
